title: Low-Cost and Real-Time Water Contamination Detection in Bangladesh: A Sensor and Machine Learning Approach
venue: 2026 13th International Conference on ICT for Smart Society (ICISS)
overview: Addressing the critical challenge of safe water access in developing regions like Bangladesh, this project introduces a rapid-prototyping solution combining IoT sensors with an advanced machine learning detection model. By moving away from slow, costly laboratory tests, our system enables real-time monitoring and immediate identification of micro-pollutants.
